title: aquilegia vulgaris subsp. atroviolacea
intro: Aquilegia vulgaris subsp. atroviolacea, commonly known as the dark red columbine, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the buttercup family Ranunculaceae. This plant is rich in health benefits, particularly in its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation due to its diuretic and vasodilatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Aquilegia vulgaris subsp. atroviolacea include its use as a diaphoretic to induce sweating and relieve fever, as well as its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
